about:
# Command Palette
This mod adds a <cg>command palette</c> to Geometry Dash.

## Usage
On PC, press <cy>Alt+Space</c> (You can change it later) to bring up the command palette.

On mobile, there should be a button in the main menu that looks like this:

![Command Palette Button](demiomad.command-palette/mobile-button-preview.png?width=32)

If you have that button, click it.
changelog:
# 2.0.0
- <cg>Fully redesigned</c> the command system
- <cg>Added</c> support for <cy>flags</c> and <cy>aliases</c>

# 1.1.0
- Made the command palette handle the ESC key.
- <cg>Fixed</c> not being able to input the period character
- <cr>Removed</c> close button (if on PC)
- <cg>Added</c> a helpful tip in the command palette :)
- <cg>Added</c> `gd stats` command (shows your statistics)

# 1.0.1
- <cy>Marked</c> Blur API as <cg>optional</c>
- <cg>Prevented</c> the command palette from being summoned inside a level

# 1.0.0
- Initial release
